_comment: Wave 4 (v323) of full coverage. Every member-voted measure-and-issue pair that stores no description anywhere and printed no line under its row: 31 pairs. Each was read from its own stored title alone. Where the title states an effect on the leaf the row sits on, one line was written from that title and the recorded outcome, and is stored once in consistency.js _DOS_EFFECT under the WAVE 4 marker; `term` is the title words the line carries. Where it does not, the row is left as it was and `why` says what the title lacks. `enactedPer` cites the record that puts an amendment’s text in public law, which is what lets its line read as done. Read by scripts/test-wave4-effect-lines.mjs. No score, weight, mapping or key is read from or written to here.

rows.title: H.Amdt. 243 (Boebert) to H.R. 8800 — strike section 521 and replace it with a prohibition on foreign nationals attending the United States Military Academies
rows.term: foreign nationals attending the United States Military Academies
rows.line: Proposed a bar on foreign nationals attending the United States Military Academies in place of section 521; the House rejected it 61-360.
